contexts.text: [F2] At every critical label the complex link-state capping form is nondegenerate and its standard module is simple ([[lem-temperley-lieb-critical-standard-modules-are-simple]]).
[F3] For $p=1$, the Gram determinant is $[t+2]_q/[1]_q$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).
[F3] The Gram determinant is the product of quantum-integer ratios with polynomial continuation at removable zero-over-zero factors ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).
[F1] At order $\ell=3$, the complex semisimplicity criterion gives semisimplicity of $\mathrm{TL}_{\ell-1}=\mathrm{TL}_2$ ([[thm-temperley-lieb-complex-semisimplicity-classification]]).

[F1] For $q=i$, $[2k]_q=0$ and $[2k+1]_q=(-1)^k$; the determinants and semisimplicity test are given by [[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]] and [[lem-temperley-lieb-cell-forms-detect-semisimplicity-over-c]].
[F2] The link-state action and rightmost-site restriction sequence are [[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-module-action-is-well-defined]] and [[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-restriction-filtration]].
[F3] For generic $q$ the link-state Gram matrix is invertible, by [[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]].

The polynomial Gram-determinant identity of [[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]] holds over every field, with polynomial continuation at zeros of displayed denominators. Let $\ell<\infty$, let $n+1=A\ell$ and $m+1=B\ell$ with $0<B\le A$ and $n-m$ even. In characteristic zero, $W_{n,m}$ is simple. In characteristic $p>0$, write $B=p^v b'$ with $p\nmid b'$ and let $b\in\{1,\ldots,p-1\}$ be the residue of $b'$ modulo $p$. If
[F1] The complex Gram determinant is $\prod_{j=1}^{(n-m)/2}([m+1+j]/[j])^{\dim W_{n,m+2j}}$, with polynomial continuation ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).

[F3] For $d_{n,r}=\binom nr-\binom n{r-1}$ with $\binom n{-1}=0$, its Gram determinant is $\displaystyle\det G_{n,p}=\prod_{j=1}^{p}\left(\frac{[t+1+j]_q}{[j]_q}\right)^{d_{n,p-j}}$, where the entire product denotes its polynomial continuation in $\delta$; individual quotients are initially rational functions ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).

[F2] Restriction from rank $n$ to rank $n-1$ has the submodule of states with a rightmost defect and quotient obtained by cutting the arc ending at $n$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-restriction-filtration]]).
[F1] The central spectral projections give the split restriction for noncritical labels ([[lem-temperley-lieb-annular-central-element-and-reflection-maps]]).
[F2] At generic $q$ all smaller-rank Gram determinants are nonzero ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).
[F3] Critical forms are nondegenerate ([[lem-temperley-lieb-critical-standard-modules-are-simple]]). The form is symmetric and invariant ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-form-is-invariant]]).
[F2] There is a nonzero map $V_{n,a}\to V_{n,p}$ for every adjacent reflected pair $a<p$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-annular-central-element-and-reflection-maps]]).
[F3] The corresponding dimensions satisfy $\dim R_{n,p}=\dim L_{n,a}$, or zero if $a$ is absent ([[lem-temperley-lieb-root-gram-rank-and-reflection-dimensions]]).

[F4] Critical standards are simple with nondegenerate form; at $\delta=0$ the positive-rank perfect-matching standard is simple despite its zero ordinary form ([[lem-temperley-lieb-critical-standard-modules-are-simple]], [[lem-temperley-lieb-zero-loop-perfect-matching-standard-module-is-simple]]).
[F6] The Gram determinant is a product of nonvanishing quantum-integer quotients when $\kappa=\infty$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).

[F2] Critical standards are simple under the divided-label digit interval, all critical standards are simple in characteristic zero, all standards are simple if $\ell=\infty$, and $W_{n,n-2}$ is simple if $[n]_\delta\ne0$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-critical-gram-unit-interval]]).
[F4] At a critical complex label the link-state capping form is nondegenerate ([[lem-temperley-lieb-critical-standard-modules-are-simple]]).
[F1] The determinant formula and its polynomial-continuation convention ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-gram-determinant]]).

[F1] Each nonexceptional standard has unique simple head $L_{n,p}$ and zero or simple radical; a nonzero radical is the head at its adjacent reflected label. These nonzero heads are pairwise distinct. At $\delta=0,n=2m>0$, $V_{2m,m}=R_{2m,m}\cong L_{2m,m-1}$ is simple and $L_{2m,m}=0$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-root-noncritical-radicals-and-simple-heads]]).
[F2] Adjacent-reflection maps exist, and the central element is scalar on each standard ([[lem-temperley-lieb-annular-central-element-and-reflection-maps]]).

[F1] The complete standard composition factors and their exceptional zero-loop convention are [[lem-temperley-lieb-root-noncritical-radicals-and-simple-heads]]. The nonzero heads are self-dual for the duality induced by diagram reflection: their nondegenerate quotient forms identify them with their twisted linear duals.
[F4] The central $F_n$, its standard eigenvalues and the induction sequences are [[lem-temperley-lieb-annular-central-element-and-reflection-maps]].

[F2] Restriction of $W_{n,m}$ to rank $n-1$ has factors $W_{n-1,m-1}$ and $W_{n-1,m+1}$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-link-state-restriction-filtration]]). Exact truncation gives $[W_{n,m}:D_{n,r}]=[W_{r,m}:D_{r,r}]$ whenever $D_{n,r}\ne0$, and $D_{r,r}$ is the trivial diagram module ([[lem-temperley-lieb-exact-truncation-reduces-decomposition-to-trivial-factors]]).

[F5] The support-character carry coefficients $\beta_{n,r}$ are nonnegative, have $\beta_{n,n}=1$, satisfy the scalar restriction identity, and every extra positive coefficient belongs to a simple standard. In the zero-loop, positive even-rank case $\beta_{n,0}=0$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-support-character-carry-and-simple-extras]]).
[F1] Since $\ell\ge3$, the complex semisimplicity theorem gives semisimplicity at rank $n=\ell-1$ ([[thm-temperley-lieb-complex-semisimplicity-classification]]).
